user.title: Heat Pump Predictor SC984
user.description: Set up the sensors of your installation. The entities must exist in Home Assistant.

data_description.modo_silent_value: Exactly as the mode select publishes it, including case and underscores: if it does not match, the Silent model never learns.
data_description.modo_boost_value: Exactly as the mode select publishes it, including case and underscores: if it does not match, the Boost model never learns.
data_description.learning_rate: Between 0.000001 and 0.1. Suggested: 0.0005 to start, 0.0002 to refine, 0.00005 for maintenance.

error.entity_not_found: Entity not found in Home Assistant

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only one is allowed: they would all store the model in the same file and overwrite each other's weights.

init.title: Options
init.description: A learning rate change applies immediately. Changing an entity or a mode value reloads the integration (the learned model is kept).

error.entity_not_found: Entity not found in Home Assistant

reset_modelo.name: Reset model
reset_modelo.description: Resets the W0 and W2 weights of both modes (Silent and Boost) to the SC984 manufacturer values.

set_learning_rate.name: Change learning rate
set_learning_rate.description: Adjusts the SGD learning rate on the fly, without reloading the integration, and stores it in the options.
